description: ODC: the REFUSAL of making a server action of an app public (InsuranceApp and CrossDevice). The headless Verify accepts, but the live ODC Studio gives an error: an ODC app does not expose a public server action. The kernel refuses at the set and points to the ways out (Public No with a consumer in the screens of the app itself, service action, or move it to a library). The clean path is in tests/jobs-odc/structure-nested.json (the same action, private).
expectError: is a server action of an ODC app
ODC apps do not expose public server actions
use a service action to serve other apps, or move it to a library
